SPIREBROTHERS-AND_YOU_KNOW_WHAT.title: And You Know What?
SPIREBROTHERS-AND_YOU_KNOW_WHAT.descript: At the start of your turn, if you played both a [gold]Logic[/gold] and a [gold]Hands[/gold] card last turn, draw 1 card.
SPIREBROTHERS-AND_YOU_KNOW_WHAT.flavor: He always has one more thing to tell you.
SPIREBROTHERS-TRUSTY_MULTIMETER.title: Trusty Multimeter
SPIREBROTHERS-TRUSTY_MULTIMETER.descript: The first time each turn a [gold]Wired[/gold] effect triggers, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-RUBBER_CHICKEN_WITH_A_PULL: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Snappy Comeback[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Nobody knows why it works. It just does.
SPIREBROTHERS-NEVER_PAID_A_MECHANIC.desc: At the end of each combat, heal [blue]5[/blue] HP.
SPIREBROTHERS-NEVER_PAID_A_MECHANIC.flav: Why pay someone when you can do it yourself?
SPIREBROTHERS-GRAPEFRUIT.title: Grapefruit
SPIREBROTHERS-GRAPEFRUIT.flavor: Read the label. He did not read the label.
